visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown hair and silver-rimmed glasses wearing a white t-shirt sits at a wooden cafe table, talking toward the camera with his hands clasped. To his right, a young boy in a white t-shirt with a cartoon graphic gestures enthusiastically. Behind them is a minimalist cafe interior featuring a white tile counter, coffee grinders, and a barista in a blue apron. (2) The man picks up a small glass of water and begins to drink while the boy continues his animated gestures. Overlays of pink and white text appear across the center of the frame. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a modern indoor commercial space. (3) The boy points his hand toward the man, who is still holding the glass to his lips. A blue speech bubble graphic appears above the boy's head. The man looks slightly toward the boy while maintaining his drinking posture. (4) The boy faces the man directly. A large, bold pink text overlay reading "GAY" flashes on the screen. The man suddenly and violently sprays the water out of his mouth in a classic spit-take reaction, looking shocked as he leans forward and coughs.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, comedic BGM featuring a steady electronic beat. An adult male voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with a friendly, narrative tone. The voice is clear with moderate conversational loudness. (2) As the man speaks, a child's voice chirps in with excited intonations. The BGM remains consistent in the background. A distinct liquid sound of someone drinking is audible. (3) The child suddenly shouts "My father!" in English with high arousal and a sharp pitch. The BGM continues its bouncy rhythm. (4) The child says the word "Gay" in a clear, matter-of-fact tone. This is immediately followed by a loud, sudden liquid-bursting sound (spit-take) and the adult male making gagging, coughing, and spluttering sounds, creating a high-arousal comedic climax.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share a humorous and unexpected moment between a father and son where the child's innocent use of a word results in a comical reaction (spit-take) from the father.
